cube3.name: CubeSat 3U
cube3.desc: About the size of a shoebox (10 × 10 × 34 cm). Very cheap, with little room and little power.
cube3.simplified: Mass, power and cost are rounded to the class of real buses of that size; the number of slots and the bus cost are our own game balance.
